programme.title: Complexx: The Two Exes

programme.title: Lethal Love Affair
programme.desc: Krystal Dunbar, is promoted as the youngest department head at her computer firm, after only four months. But, after an encounter with Zoey Kendricks, a beautiful and mysterious new arrival to town, Krystal's world is turned upside down. When their brief romance begins to conflict with Krystal's career aspirations, she quickly halts the relationship, sending Zoey’s emotions spiraling downward.

programme.title: Pinch
programme.desc: A talented MC uses larceny to fund his dreams of becoming a rap star, but his life changes when he meets Allie, now the once self-centered thief is transformed into the Robin Hood for the hood.

programme.title: Princess of the Trap House

Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: Quiet as Kept

As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

programme.title: Say Less

As the police try to find evidence to convict Donta, her friends must find the strength to find out the truth, and seek justice for Kimbra’s death.

programme.title: Kinfolk

Meanwhile, their estranged father's attempts to reconcile with his past create further challenges.

programme.title: The Love We Had
programme.desc: One decision results in a tragedy that threatens to rip a young couple apart at the seams while essentially destroying everything and everyone who means the most to them.

programme.title: The Housekeeper

programme.title: Her Other Man
